interface.title: NeuroCrop – Maize Yield Predictor (Streamlit dashboard)
interface.field: Plant breeding / maize genomics × environment (G2F multi-location hybrid trials)
interface.stage_of_work: Decision support before field trials: picking crosses and test sites from pre-computed model predictions
interface.what_it_is_for: Look up the XGBoost-predicted grain yield of a maize hybrid (female × male inbred) at any of 38 US Genomes-to-Fields locations, then rank locations and crosses, compare hybrids, and judge G×E stability.

data.note: The app loads a committed database of 2,994,894 pre-computed predictions (2,912 hybrids, 38 locations, G2F 2014–2018). Mean is 140.5 bu/A and range is 51.4–218.8. No network fallback was used. The test file batch_crosses.csv (6 rows) was uploaded to Batch Predict. Line names in the database are upper-case (MO17, OH43). The CSV and the app's own template use 'Mo17'/'Oh43'. The template file itself was never downloaded in the trace. Reciprocal crosses (A × B and B × A) are stored as separate hybrids with the same predicted value.

features.name: Linked parent/environment picker with predicted-value card
features.general: Choose a female (seed) parent, then a male (pollen) parent from a type-ahead list narrowed to partners actually crossed with that female, then a test environment. Read back the predicted value for that cross there, its percentile within that environment, a category badge, and a gauge against the overall mean.
features.specific: Sidebar ♀ Female Parent → ♂ Male Parent (restricted to males crossed with that female; the run reported 63 for B73, but no kept screen shows the count) → 📍 Location. The sidebar card and Predict tab show bu/A, 'Top x% at location', 🟢/🟡/🔴 category, a gauge and 'vs overall avg'. Every other tab uses these choices. The 'Feature Contribution' bars on the prediction are the same for every cross (41.1/23.7/18.9/16.3%). They are fixed global model importances, not a breakdown of the chosen cross. The Quick Location Scout under the card is a compact version of f2.
steps: type or pick a female line
pick a male line from the narrowed list
read yield, percentile and category in the card and gauge
serves_tasks: Predict the outcome for a chosen pair of parents in a chosen environment

features.name: Single-prediction report export
features.general: From the current single prediction (one female × male parent pair in one environment), download a one-page report file named after the cross and environment.
features.specific: 📄 Download PDF Report under the prediction saves neurocrop_<F>_<M>_<LOC>.pdf, a small ReportLab PDF (2.7 KB for B73 × MO17 @ ILH1). The replay saved neurocrop_B73_MO17_GAH1.pdf. The report's contents were not inspected in this run.
steps: pick the cross and location in the sidebar
serves_tasks: Save a one-page report of a single prediction

features.name: Ranked environments view with switchable chart mode and export
features.general: For one chosen cross, rank all test environments by predicted value. Show the top 3 as cards and switch between a bar chart, a value-vs-percentile scatter and a sorted list with a minimum-value slider. Export the ranking as CSV.
features.specific: Best Location tab: top-3 location cards, 'Chart view' radio (Bar / Scatter (Yield vs Percentile) / Sorted Table with 'Filter: min yield' slider) and 📥 Download CSV (best_locs_<F>_<M>.csv with Location, Yield, Percentile, Category). The CSV always holds all 38 locations and ignores the min-yield slider. The explorer saw this at slider 169 (no surviving screen). The replay saw it at slider 155, where the on-screen list showed 17 locations.
steps: pick the cross in the sidebar
switch Chart view (Bar / Scatter / Sorted Table)
in Sorted Table, drag the min-yield slider
serves_tasks: Rank all environments for a chosen candidate and pick the best test sites

features.name: Top-N leaderboard with sort, name filter and export
features.general: List the N best (or worst) crosses in one environment. Includes a slider for N, a sort-direction choice, a text filter on parent names, a matching bar chart and CSV export.
features.specific: Best Cross tab: 'Show top N' slider (5–50), 'Sort by' Yield ↓/↑, '🔍 Filter by parent name' text box, a ranked list, a horizontal bar chart and 📥 Download CSV (top_crosses_<LOC>.csv). The filter only searches inside the current top/bottom N; in the replay, 'LH162' matched 5 of the bottom 21 at GAH1. Reciprocal crosses (e.g. LH198 × LH185 and LH185 × LH198) take two rows with the same value.
steps: pick a location in the sidebar
type a parent name to filter
serves_tasks: Find the best-performing candidates in one environment

features.name: Genotype × environment interaction profile and heatmap
features.general: Choose several female parents crossed to one fixed tester parent. Plot each hybrid's predicted value across all environments as lines against the grand mean. Show the same data as a heatmap that toggles between absolute values and deviation from each hybrid's own mean. List which hybrid wins in each environment.
features.specific: G×E Analysis tab: 'Female Parents' multiselect chips plus a 'Fixed Male Parent' select. Shows a 'G×E Interaction Profile' line chart with a grand-mean line, a 'G×E Heatmap' with 'Heatmap view' Absolute Yield / Deviation from Hybrid Mean, and the '🏆 Which hybrid wins at each location?' expander. Changing the fixed male was not tried.
steps: add or remove female parents in the multiselect
read crossing vs parallel lines in the profile
switch the heatmap to Deviation from Hybrid Mean
serves_tasks: See how candidates' rankings change from environment to environment (interaction)

features.name: Threshold-filtered stability ranking
features.general: Filter hybrids by minimum mean, maximum coefficient of variation across environments and minimum number of environments tested. See counts per stability class, a chart (scatter, top-20 bubble or histogram), and a ranked table of mean, SD, CV% and N that can be exported.
features.specific: Stability tab: sliders for Min mean yield (bu/A), Max CV% (1–30) and Min locations tested. Shows ✅ Stable / Moderate / Unstable badges 'of N hybrids shown', a Chart radio (Scatter / Top 20 Bubble / Histogram) and a table (Hybrid, Mean_Yield, Std_Yield, CV_pct, N_Locs, Stability). Default thresholds return no hybrids. Relaxing CV to 30 gives 80 hybrids, all Unstable (CV ≈ 22%). Reciprocal crosses appear as separate rows with identical stats. The reviewer's reading of the code shows a 'Download Table' (stability.csv) export, which was not pressed in this run.
steps: switch the chart type and read the ranked table
serves_tasks: Rank candidates by stability and pick widely adapted ones

features.name: Side-by-side multi-hybrid comparison
features.general: Choose how many crosses to compare (2–4), each with its own female parent, male parent and environment selectors. See a result card per cross, a comparison bar chart, an all-environments line profile, and a table with CSV export.
features.specific: Compare Hybrids tab: 'Number of hybrids to compare' radio 2/3/4 spawns Female n / Male n / Location n selectors. Shows hybrid cards (bu/A, Top x% at location, category), a 'Yield Comparison' bar chart, a 'Yield Profile Across All Locations' line chart, a data table (mean, CV%, stability) and 📥 Download CSV (comparison.csv in the replay).
steps: set female, male and location for each
read the cards and comparison bar
serves_tasks: Put several candidates side by side

features.name: Batch lookup from an uploaded CSV
features.general: Upload a table of female parent × male parent × environment combinations in a fixed column layout (template downloadable). Preview the parsed rows, run them all, and get a results table to export. Rows not found in the database are reported.
features.specific: Batch Predict tab: example table plus 📥 Download Template, 'Upload CSV' drop zone, 'N rows' preview, and 🔮 Run All Predictions. In this run all 6 rows returned the single message 'No predictions found…'. Matching is exact, and the file's mixed-case Mo17/Oh43 do not match the database's MO17/OH43. The all-upper-case row 2FACC/3IIH6 @ INH1 also failed, so case is not the whole cause; that combination may be absent from the database. The results table and its CSV/Excel export only render once a batch returns rows (per the reviewer's reading of app.py:913-941). They are described from the code, not seen.
steps: upload a CSV with Female, Male, Location
read the results or the not-found message
serves_tasks: Run a whole list of candidate crosses at once from a file

features.name: Prediction-database summary explorer
features.general: Sub-tabs that summarise the whole prediction set: overall distribution with category thresholds and summary metrics, per-environment mean ± SD with an exportable table, and the top female and male parents by mean predicted value.
features.specific: Yield Explorer tab with three sub-tabs. Distribution: histogram of 2,994,894 predictions with Mean/Medium/High threshold lines, a metrics row and a category donut. By Location: mean ± std bars and a Location/Mean/Std/N table. Parent Effects: Top 20 female and Top 20 male parents. The reviewer's reading of the code shows a 'Location Stats CSV' (location_stats.csv) export, which was not pressed in this run.
steps: read the Distribution histogram and metrics
switch to By Location and read or export the table
serves_tasks: Look at summary statistics of all predictions

features.name: Model-trust panel
features.general: Show how much each group of model inputs (genetics, plant traits, weather, soil) drives the predictions. Compare the cross-validated and test accuracy (R²) of an earlier model with the current one, with a note explaining why the earlier figures were inflated.
features.specific: Model Insights tab, per the replay: grouped importance Genetics 41.1%, Plant Traits 23.7%, Season Weather 18.9%, Critical-Period Weather 16.3%, Soil 0.0%. It compares 2017 RF (CV 0.572 / Test 0.635) with 2014–2018 XGBoost (CV 0.355 / Test 0.361), plus a note that the old CV had leakage. The About tab gives the architecture.
steps: read the old-vs-current R² comparison and the leakage note
serves_tasks: Check how much to trust the model
